messages:
alex: Hey team — customer acct-acme reported intermittent 429 spikes when they fanout requests to multiple model variants (rwd-large, rwd-large-quant) with very long contexts (~62k). They also see auth failures right after their token rotation. Sample curl and response below.

tara: Can you paste a minimal repro + any response headers? Are they doing parallel fanout or sequential?

alex: Repro snippet:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"<~62k tokens...>","fanout":["rwd-large","rwd-large-quant"],"stream":false}' &

# responses seen:
# HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
# Retry-After: 3
# {"error":"per_model_quota","detail":"model rwd-large exceeded tpm"}

# then sometimes shortly after:
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
# X-Auth-Error: token_mismatch
```

cheng: @alex thanks. Two separate signals: 1) per-model TPM/RPM + concurrency — long contexts = many tokens per request so per-model TPM can be exhausted quickly when fanouting. 2) concurrent queues per model cause 429s when concurrency cap reached. 3) the 401 looks like a client-side token swap race where refresh rotated creds but some inflight requests keep using old token; backend rejects with 401 and we produce the X-Auth-Error header.

tara: Short repro steps to recommend to customer:
- reduce context or send shorter prefix (test ~32k)
- avoid parallel fanout to multiple heavy models; serialize or use single model; or stagger requests
- honor `Retry-After` and implement exponential backoff + jitter
- verify token rotation flow: refresh then retry logic should fetch new token before next request

alex: Billing question from customer: they see token counts billed even for 429s. Any clarity?

cheng: Quick answer: tokens are recorded when the request is accepted by the router. If we return 429 before acceptance there's no billing. But large requests that make it into the model queue may incur partial token accounting. I'll confirm with billing. If we reproduce, include trace ids so billing can look up intake vs accepted.

tara: Action items:
- @cheng capture traces for acct-acme for window 2026-03-15T14:00-14:10 (they provided an example)
- @alex ask customer to run reduced-context repro and share headers + trace-id
- @eng-sre-bot can we temporarily bump per-model TPM for acct-acme to see if it stabilizes? If yes, propose move to Dedicated.

eng-sre-bot: incident-note: quota_adjust_request created (req-7891) by tara — pending approval.

cheng: I'm taking ownership. I'll:
- check `rwdctl quotas get --customer acct-acme --model rwd-large`
- review router traces for `trace_id` from their logs
- confirm billing behavior with finance

alex: thanks — I'll send customer a short repro template and ask for trace ids. :thumbsup:

tara: ping if you need me for the quota bump or customer call. :phone:

cheng: update: found replayable queue depth spike — looks like their fanout parallelism of 4 for each user request caused transient per-model TPM bursts. Proposed mitigation: client-side limit fanout concurrency to 1-2 and use model variants with lower token cost (quant). Also we can auto-fallback to a cheaper model on overload.

alex: closing loop with customer now.
